# Set up a Fully Kiosk tablet as a picture frame with one tap
### New
- **Set up a tablet with Fully Kiosk from the app:** Devices → ⚙ → "Set up and control the tablet". Answer four simple questions (orientation, screen always on, start after reboot / power cut, reload after a network outage; brightness is optional) and give the server address. Frameside then sets about 25 Fully settings through its remote administration, **including the start address** - nobody has to type a URL into the kiosk browser any more. **Set up** can be repeated at any time (it only changes what differs), **Check** lists settings that someone changed on the tablet, and your choices stay saved and editable. For tablets the server cannot reach (for example at your parents'): **Download settings file** and import it in Fully.
- **Android app "Frameside" for tablets too:** starts after the device is switched on (menu → "Allow start after power-on", one-time "Display over other apps" permission); on a tablet a long press on the picture opens the menu. Version 1.1.0.
### Fixed
- **A tablet locked itself out while pairing ("?" instead of the code):** a device that keeps reloading its page (for example Fully with "reload every 60 seconds") fetched a new pairing code every time and was blocked after five open codes. It now keeps its code as long as it is unassigned; while blocked the page shows "…" and keeps trying.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
